# Data Integrity Checklist: SPEC-014C First Real Harness Adapter Pilot

**Purpose**: Validate data-integrity requirement quality for the Codex app-server adapter, including no-migration scope, bounded evidence reuse, ownership re-proof, cleanup ordering, no-mutation guards, and zero-residue UAT.
**Created**: 2026-06-05
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Schema And Storage Scope

- [x] CHK001 Is the no-schema-migration decision stated consistently across the spec, plan, and data model? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions; Plan §Technical Context; Data Model §Storage Decision]
- [x] CHK002 Are the conditions that would force a schema-heavy split decision documented before implementation proceeds? [Coverage, Spec §Reviewability Budget; Plan §Complexity Tracking]
- [x] CHK003 Are existing storage surfaces named precisely enough to avoid inventing new durable tables for SPEC-014C evidence? [Completeness, Spec FR-012; Plan §Technical Context; Data Model §Storage Decision]
- [x] CHK004 Are run, task-stage attempt, claim, sandbox lifecycle, activity, usage/failure, and artifact-reference records described as reused evidence surfaces rather than new sources of authority? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions; Plan §Evidence And Artifacts; Data Model §Adapter Run Evidence]

## Evidence Integrity

- [x] CHK005 Is `codex_app_server_run.v1` defined as descriptor-only metadata with bounded identifiers, counts, statuses, outcomes, phases, usage, safety, failure, and artifact-reference fields? [Completeness, Spec FR-012; Data Model §Adapter Run Evidence; Schema §codex_app_server_run.v1]
- [x] CHK006 Are safe artifact references limited to descriptor fields while forbidden storage URIs, raw content, previews, filenames, paths, URLs, payloads, transcripts, prompt bodies, and secrets are excluded? [Clarity, Spec Clarifications §Evidence, Artifacts, And Redaction; Data Model §Safe Artifact Reference]
- [x] CHK007 Are bounded evidence writes specified to preserve existing append/audit semantics rather than overwriting claim, attempt, lifecycle, artifact, or activity history? [Consistency, Spec FR-021-FR-022; Contract §Evidence Write Ordering]
- [x] CHK008 Does the schema and contract distinguish blocked-before-launch evidence, where some identifiers may be absent, from launched or terminal evidence that requires current ownership, manifest, and lifecycle identifiers? [Clarity, Data Model §Runtime Inventory Eligibility Decision; Contract §Dispatch Admission; Schema §codex_app_server_run.v1]

## Ownership And Idempotency

- [x] CHK009 Are ownership re-proof points specified before launch, continuation, terminal evidence writes, claim release, and lifecycle terminal marking? [Coverage, Spec Clarifications §Claim, Timeout, And Lifecycle Semantics; Contract §Ownership Re-Proof Points]
- [x] CHK010 Are same-run continuation requirements bounded to the same live process, thread, claim, and attempt, with cross-tick resume excluded? [Clarity, Spec Clarifications §Codex App-Server Protocol; Data Model §Codex App-Server Protocol Session]
- [x] CHK011 Are success, timeout, failure, and abandoned-by-claim-control outcomes mapped to claim release reasons and attempt states without making claim release state the retry authority? [Consistency, Spec FR-021; Plan §Terminal Mapping; Data Model §Claimed Stage Attempt]
- [x] CHK012 Are stale ownership, claim-control, and late-terminal-write races required to avoid overwriting newer claim, attempt, task, GitHub, successor, or governance state? [Coverage, Spec Clarifications §Claim, Timeout, And Lifecycle Semantics; Contract §Ownership Re-Proof Points]

## No-Mutation Boundary

- [x] CHK013 Are direct task terminal state, successor selection, direct GitHub mutation, auto-merge, Aegis/owner gates, and governance policy changes excluded from the adapter path? [Completeness, Spec FR-020; Contract §No-Mutation Guard]
- [x] CHK014 Are static and runtime guard requirements measurable against SPEC-014C-owned adapter/dispatch files without blocking pre-existing legacy dispatch behavior? [Measurability, Spec Clarifications §Claim, Timeout, And Lifecycle Semantics; Plan §Scope Guard]
- [x] CHK015 Are runtime inventory, sandbox lifecycle, claim, and task-stage attempt records kept within their existing authority boundaries so derived eligibility cannot become active claim or lifecycle authority? [Consistency, Spec §Key Entities; Plan §Dispatch Integration; Data Model §Runtime Inventory Eligibility Decision]

## Cleanup And Residue

- [x] CHK016 Is cleanup ordering specified so terminal run/attempt/failure evidence is recorded before subprocess termination, lifecycle terminal marking, and cleanup requests? [Clarity, Spec Clarifications §Claim, Timeout, And Lifecycle Semantics; Contract §Evidence Write Ordering]
- [x] CHK017 Are subprocess termination failures and lifecycle cleanup failures required to append bounded `cleanup_failed` or termination-failure evidence while preserving inspectable lifecycle state? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases; Data Model §Paddock-Owned Sandbox Lifecycle]
- [x] CHK018 Are HAL UAT zero-residue requirements defined for marker-scoped disposable DB rows plus sandbox and artifact paths after report capture? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec FR-024; Spec SC-007; Data Model §HAL UAT Fixture]

## UAT Data Integrity

- [x] CHK019 Is the HAL UAT fixture shape complete for workspace, operator session, project, workflow stage, assignment, GitHub-linked task, sync evidence, stage attempt, active claim, sandbox lifecycle, run/artifact/activity evidence, and cleanup proof? [Completeness, Spec Clarifications §UAT And Deployment; Data Model §HAL UAT Fixture]
- [x] CHK020 Are deterministic negative fixtures allowed only when they exercise the same parser, failure mapper, timeout, lifecycle, and artifact/redaction paths as live protocol events? [Consistency, Spec Clarifications §UAT And Deployment; Data Model §HAL UAT Fixture]
- [x] CHK021 Is fake-only evidence explicitly insufficient for completion of the real-launch data-integrity gate? [Clarity, Spec FR-023-FR-024; Spec SC-007]

## Cross-Artifact Consistency

- [x] CHK022 Are blocked and failure reason codes consistent across spec, plan terminal mapping, data model, adapter contract, dispatch/evidence contract, and JSON schema? [Consistency, Spec FR-016-FR-019; Plan §Terminal Mapping; Data Model §Failure Summary; Schema §codex_app_server_run.v1]
- [x] CHK023 Are success, timeout, unsafe evidence, abandoned ownership, and cleanup-failure terminal mappings consistent between requirements and contracts? [Consistency, Spec Clarifications §Claim, Timeout, And Lifecycle Semantics; Plan §Terminal Mapping; Contract §Evidence Write Ordering]
- [x] CHK024 Are data-integrity success criteria objectively measurable for one real launch, blocked ineligible cases, failure reasons, no direct mutation, safe evidence, operator distinguishability, zero residue, and PR traceability? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec SC-001-SC-008]

- Focus areas selected: schema/no-migration scope, existing evidence surfaces, ownership/idempotency re-proof, no task terminal/GitHub mutation, cleanup ordering, and zero-residue HAL UAT.
